### Interface Unveils Twist & Texture™ Carpet Tile Collection


October 13, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/354928249/files/doc_news/Interface-Unveils-Twist--Texture-Carpet-Tile-Collection-2026.pdf)


*Newest Styles Pair Premium Textile Looks with Unmatched Value and Short Lead Times*


ATLANTA--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Interface, Inc., the global flooring and sustainability leader, today introduced Twist & Texture™, its latest carpet tile collection featuring seven textile-inspired styles. For designers managing fast-moving projects, the collection pairs sophisticated design with one affordable price point and three-week[QuickShip](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.interface.com%2FUS%2Fen-US%2Fcarpet-tile%2Fquick-ship.html&esheet=54588372&newsitemid=20261013822912&lan=en-US&anchor=QuickShip&index=1&md5=73c5e38076a773551e33d8c9b4191f8c) availability. Its color palette of warm neutrals and subtle accents gives designers the flexibility to create calm, inviting spaces across a variety of commercial environments.


Inspired by handcrafted textile traditions, Twist & Texture translates woven textures, cross-hatched patterns, braided diagonals, and warm colorways into modular carpet tile for commercial interiors. Each style can be used in a range of applications, supporting everything from quiet, refined interiors to dynamic, collaborative zones, for workplaces, education environments, senior living spaces, and more.


“We’re seeing a growing interest in handcrafted, classically tailored looks across today’s commercial spaces. Designers are increasingly using texture and color to create spaces that feel warmer, more layered, and more inviting,” said Anne Marie Lisko, Vice President of Global Product Category Management at Interface. “At the same time, they’re balancing project budgets and quick timelines. Twist & Texture brings those priorities together in one collection, delivering craft-inspired visuals with the flexibility and reliability designers need to bring projects to life.”


**Twist & Texture: Craft-Inspired Carpet Tile Collection**


Twist & Texture brings intricate detail, organic movement, and rich warmth to the floor through seven coordinating styles:


- Knitstitch™
- Knit Intent™
- In The Fold™
- Line of Thought™
- On An Angle™
- Another Angle™
- Fringe Benefits™


Each style is available in nine warm neutrals and nine subtle accent colorways. The collection offers:


- **Textile-inspired carpet tile designs.** From signature cross-hatched patterns to braided diagonals and tailored woven textures, the seven styles offer their own expression while working together effortlessly.
- **Flexible color options.** Warm, timeless neutrals paired with subtle accents make it easy to create inviting spaces, support zoning and wayfinding, and introduce visual interest.
- **Three-week QuickShip availability.** Every style, color, and quantity is available through Interface's QuickShip program, helping teams meet project timelines.
- **One price point across the collection.** A consistent price point makes specifying textile-inspired flooring simple.


Twist & Texture is designed with the full life cycle in mind. By prioritizing modular design, carbon-storing materials, and end-of-life solutions, Interface is advancing a[circular economy](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.interface.com%2FUS%2Fen-US%2Fsustainability%2Fdriven-by-circularity&esheet=54588372&newsitemid=20261013822912&lan=en-US&anchor=circular+economy&index=2&md5=3f1976877d8db045d5a01962c4f537e4) and closing the loop across its product portfolio.


Additionally, the collection pairs effortlessly with Interface’s comprehensive portfolio of[carpet tile,](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fshop.interface.com%2FUS%2Fen-US%2Fcarpet-tile%2F&esheet=54588372&newsitemid=20261013822912&lan=en-US&anchor=carpet+tile%2C&index=3&md5=7b4f77b02a3156d062cfcd787024ad2e)[LVT](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fshop.interface.com%2FUS%2Fen-US%2Fresilient%2Flvt%2F&esheet=54588372&newsitemid=20261013822912&lan=en-US&anchor=LVT&index=4&md5=91bb856482c97a5e4217de4c33644561) , and[nora® rubber flooring](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fshop.interface.com%2FUS%2Fen-US%2Fresilient%2Fnora-rubber%2F&esheet=54588372&newsitemid=20261013822912&lan=en-US&anchor=nora%26%23174%3B+rubber+flooring&index=5&md5=6ead6cd13df4795ef872a1cc8ac4995b) . It is made with purpose and without compromising on design, performance, or sustainability.


To learn more about Interface and its portfolio of flooring solutions, visit[www.interface.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.interface.com&esheet=54588372&newsitemid=20261013822912&lan=en-US&anchor=www.interface.com&index=6&md5=8bb30821597d48c3a407699b18f5d2cd) .


**About Interface**


Interface is a global flooring and sustainability leader dedicated to rethinking how spaces work for people and the planet. Our portfolio includes Interface® carpet tile and LVT, nora® rubber flooring, and FLOR® premium area rugs. Across every brand, we innovate in a way that combines design, performance, and sustainability—without compromise.


Trusted by architects, designers, and building professionals worldwide, we help bring bold visions to life with solutions that deliver real, measurable impact. Building on more than 30 years of sustainability progress and industry first innovation, we remain ‘all in’ on our goal of becoming carbon negative by 2040, without the use of offsets.
